limitations: 8 of 14 scenario transactions with a usable request line retained no response body; tools citing them replay only the recorded status and content type, either of which may be absent.
Artifact identity is unavailable for this observation.
Browser host platform and architecture were not observed.

Captured response-body bytes are the result of Playwright's Response.body() API. Playwright may satisfy that API with a credentialed follow-up load of the request URL when CDP has no body, so transaction and event links do not verify that retained bytes came from the original network transaction.
Event sequence records provider receipt order; simultaneous browser causality is not inferred.
Network content is retained only when selected; Playwright response-body bytes are API results and are not guaranteed to match wire bytes.
Network content reads settle within 5 seconds each and the observer does not request bodies from unfinished responses.
Observed query parameter names do not establish required parameters, value types or a complete API schema.
Opt-in template rules after-uid-literal, opaque-token, prefix-variance, sibling-variance merge recorded literals by shape; merged parameters may conflate distinct resources.
Playwright scenario events do not expose request initiator stacks; receipt order does not prove causality.
Request bytes are limited to what Playwright exposes; not_exposed does not establish body absence or multipart file coverage.

Scenario record start times are the browser's own, from when the request ended, or when the provider observed the request where the browser reported none; durations are the browser's own, or 0 where it reported none.
Scenario records are the capture's network transactions in request order; each record ordinal is the transaction's zero-based position.
Some selected network content was unavailable; per-transaction content states retain the reason.
Storage values are hashed only after declared-secret redaction.
Tool templates, parameters and names are inferences from recorded request lines; they do not establish handler identity, URL-space schemas or causality.

unknowns.statement: Authorization headers and cookies are structurally excluded from captures; the manifest states no authorization model.
Recorded statuses and bodies are retained only as pointers to parent records; the manifest states no response semantics.
Recorded exchanges are independent observations; the manifest states no ordering, side effects or state transitions between tools.
